name: unsafe fn clone_to_uninit (& self , dest : * mut u8)
rule: After `clone_to_uninit` returns normally, it is sound to create a `&Self` reference from `dest` using the pointer metadata from `self`.
api: trait CloneToUninit  : { unsafe fn clone_to_uninit (& self , dest : * mut u8) }
expression: This requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL: it requires post-return observations and a `Self`-typed pointee view using `self`’s metadata, neither of which is available.
